featured_reviews.name: Ayub Sayyed
featured_reviews.review_text:
3/5 stars

I ordered 4 pizzas from Tazza Fast Food and here's my experience:

The chicken pieces used as toppings were fantastic! However, the pizza crust was just fine. The main letdown was the cheese it tasted like local/adulterated cheese, lacking the rich flavor we expect. Additionally, the chicken spices had a sweeter tone that didn't quite work for us.

Maybe with some tweaks to the cheese and spice blend, Tazza could take their pizzas to the next level.

Requesting you to please serve quality cheese in your pizzas. It would make a huge difference.

featured_reviews.name: Anushka Dutta
featured_reviews.review_text: Randomly stumbled across this spot in Mahim and it was an absolute gem! The food was amazing with very generous portion sizes. It was also extremely budget friendly without compromising on the quality. The food was made fresh- even the choco lava cake batter was made in the spot! Other than that, I would recommend the cheesy pink pasta and the smoky chicken burger. Will definitely be back to try the rest of the menu🥰

featured_reviews.name: Mohd Mehmood
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dropped by Bites’ N Grill in Mahim and it turned out to be an amazing food experience!

🍗 The Crispy Chicken Fingers were perfectly cooked – crunchy on the outside and tender inside, served with a tangy-spicy dip that made them irresistible.
🍕 The non-veg pizza was loaded with toppings like jalapenos, olives, onions, and capsicum, with the right amount of cheese – every bite was bursting with flavor.
🍔 The chicken burger was big, juicy, and layered with fresh onions, lettuce, creamy sauce, and a generous slice of cheese – a real hunger buster.
🥤 Ended the meal with their rich and indulgent Chocolate Shake, thick, creamy, and the perfect dessert-in-a-glass.

The food portions were generous, flavors well-balanced, and it’s definitely a great spot for comfort food cravings in Mahim.

✨ And yes, the food here is 100% Halal, which makes it even better!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (5/5) – Highly recommended for anyone who loves burgers, pizza, and crispy delights!

featured_reviews.name: Thobias Ainickal
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely phenomenal experience at Bites and Grills! Their burger is hands down the best I've ever tasted, juicy and flavorful, truly a five-star delight. The garlic bread is a heavenly combination of crispy outside and soft inside, a perfect appetizer. And let's talk about their Watermelon Punch – refreshing, tangy, and utterly delicious! Highly recommend this place for foodies looking for top-notch flavors and a fantastic dining experience.

featured_reviews.name: urmi chhapia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Feel like having a pocket friendly meal? Head to Bites and Grill! There’s Greek paintings on the wall and bougainvillea too! A cute cafe with lovely food and tasty drinks to fit your budget! We headed there for dinner the other day and tried:

Drinks
Pina Colada was mildly sweet with a dash of pineapple and lots of vanilla.

Blue moon was fruity and fresh. Fruit juices with blue curacao syrup was fantastic.

Mains
Pizza- Burnt garlic (big)
Pizza was soft and well made. The sauce was delicious and the pizza was cheesy. Soft dough and yummy cheese and sauce. A must try.

Ago o lio was good. Light on taste and plenty of olives and other veggies.

Mak and cheese burger veg
Very tasty. I’d say the best one I have had in a while! The patty was tasty and cheese slice and sauces gave the irresistible flavour.

We would like to thank our lady server for her quick and excellent service!

featured_reviews.name: Sunny Gurnani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Updated review:

This use to be one of my favorite burger joint however it is sad to see how the taste, quality and portion has stepped down. The change has been visible from quite sometime and with a hope of improvement ilI shared the feedback multiple times. The burgers now and the ones served earlier has a difference that can be picked by its taste and portion size.
__________________________________________________

Off lately modern burgers have become the basic need for burger cravings and while every new brand comes with something new and fancy, the pricing has become a concern coz usually they charge a good high price like 400 and more for a burger however I was thrilled to find Bites n Grill serving burgers at a price one cannot say No to try them. While online food ordering has a price much higher than original restaurant cost we still have to order for the luxury of order being delivered at door step however bites n grill has been courteous to deliver their lip smacking food at my doorstep on multiple occasions at no extra cost. Infact ordering via them is cheaper than any ordering app.

Coming to the food and taste, I have tried their crispy chicken burgers, bites n grill special chicken burger and jack stax burger till now and not for once I was disappointed as their burgers are juicy with fresh veggies and amazing sauces. It comes with complimentary fries or Wafers by the side all at under 200rs each. Great service, delicious and hygienic food with no pinch on your pocket. Couldn't have ask for more. It has become my all time best joint for burgers until I try more of their food items soon

featured_reviews.review_text:
Variety of dishes available in both veg & non veg. Fascinated by the menu they offer. The packaging and presentation of the dishes are on point. Loved the quality & portion provided. Being a burger lover I opted for the Hybrid burger which came in 2 layer of burgers...So filling for 2 people.
Other dishes tried:

BBQ chicken pizza (cheesy & fresh loaded with chicken)
Blue lagoon
Crispy fried chicken ( crunchy coated chicken)
Chicken steak (perfectly grilled chicken with smashed cheesy potatoes & veggies)

All the dishes were freshly prepared, delicious & presentable. The rates are also perfect as per the dishes. Highly recommended place...

We tried the Chicken Manchow Soup, the Chicken Cheese Kurkure Momos, and the Chicken Chilly Fried Rice and every dish was an absolute delight. featured_reviews.name: Dev Mody
featured_reviews.review_text:
Here you go:

I never wrote a review before — after eating here for so long — but I had to today, for a particular reason.
Any real Scottishite has eaten here countless times. Rushed to grab his Frankies in a crowd, with friends, with a crush, or alone. It's cheap, delicious, and insane value.
I've been coming for about 5-ish years; my brother went for almost 9 years when he was in school. I'm writing this review because allegedly he's leaving this monsoon until around 2030 due to redevelopment, and is moving to a bigger, actual store — which means his prices are going to shoot up like crazy. Right now he's still got insane value for money: just ₹70 for a Frankie roll, and around ₹500–700 for 6–8 rolls.
God knows whether his prices will even stay the same when he returns, or if the old Bahadur himself will still be around. So enjoy as much as possible till this monsoon.
Goodbye, old Bahadur. 😔🥲
Apparently a nearby mom-and-pop shop will be serving Frankies in the meantime, but it won't be the same. We'll miss you, Bahadur — especially the old version. As much as I loved him and want him to stay , that's just the cycle of Mumbai, man.
Is it true tu sachi me nikalra he when are you coming back bahadur ?

featured_reviews.name: Shk King
featured_reviews.review_text:
We've been a regular at Burger Junction Apna Point Junction for over two years, visiting about three times a month. Their food and prices are great, which is why we've been a loyal customer for so long. However, my recent experience has completely changed my mind.

Last night, we placed an order for around Rs.600/- and the owner asked us to pay Rs.650/- which seemed suspicious, but we decided to ask for an invoice for the first time in these 2 years. The owner claimed it would take 15–20 minutes to download the invoice because their system was "restarting." This made us even more suspicious, so we left without the invoice.

When we calculated the bill outside, we realized we had been overcharged. We went back to confront them, and they admitted to making a mistake, saying they "accidentally added two double-decker burgers instead of one," which increased the bill by Rs.50/-. However, a double-decker burger costs Rs.150/-, so this explanation doesn't add up.

This isn't about the Rs.50/- it's about the feeling of being cheated. As a long-time customer who never questioned my bill before, I now feel like I may have been overcharged for months. I won't be returning to this place.

I urge anyone visiting to always ask for your invoice and cross-check it against the menu before paying. It's a shame, as this used to be our favorite spot.

I visited the store around 1:00 AM to place a Subway order. A staff member named Adil initially told me that takeaway orders were available but dining in was not allowed. However, at the same time, there were three people already dining inside the store, which was confusing.

While I was trying to place my order, a female staff member from the back suddenly intervened very rudely and denied service. She said nothing was available, even though Adil had just told me takeaway was possible. Her tone was extremely rude and unprofessional.

Additionally, Google shows that this outlet is open until 3:00 AM, and there was no sign or notice outside stating that orders were only for Swiggy/Zomato or that dining/takeaway restrictions applied. Instead of explaining the situation politely, the staff started speaking very rudely and even raised their voices when I tried to clarify.

This experience was very disappointing. The staff behaved in a pathetic and unprofessional manner and clearly lack basic customer service skills.

My personal opinion: I would not recommend visiting this particular store because the staff does not know how to speak to customers. I have also recorded that lady rude behaviour.

@Subway – please look into this issue. Staff behavior like this damages your brand image hope you will remove this staff and take strict actions.

featured_reviews.name: mayur kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
This food corner near Shivaji Park, Dadar, is a spot for non-veg lovers. They serve delicious dishes like chicken tandoori, kababs, tikka, and egg rolls, and the open-dining setup adds to the casual street-food vibe. Seating is simple, with small stools placed along the footpath, making it a unique experience.

I tried their Chicken Tikka and Tandoori Chicken, and both were flavorful and well-cooked. The service is impressively fast, ensuring you don't have to wait long for your food.

***I noticed that the prices have been hiked recently, which makes it a bit less affordable than before.

Overall, it’s a good place to enjoy tasty non-veg food in a casual setting. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area
